title: Freeport: Leverage, Global Markets, 24/7
summary: Leverage, U.S. and international markets, pre-IPO access, and private onchain trading in one mobile app.
body_markdown:
Freeport puts professional market access in a mobile app: leveraged trading 24/7 across U.S. and international markets, pre-IPO exposure, and a private onchain account with no KYC for core trading.


## U.S. and international markets—with leverage, 24/7


Trade U.S. stocks alongside opportunities that most domestic brokers make difficult to reach: Chinese frontier labs and robotics, Korean memory producers, Japanese semiconductor materials, and other global bottlenecks. Supported markets run through nights and weekends, and you can go long or short with leverage where available.


## Pre-IPO access before the public listing


Freeport also provides exposure to private-market names that most brokerage accounts cannot offer, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Anduril, Kalshi, and Polymarket. Depending on the market, that exposure may use a tokenized product or a perpetual contract, and the app shows the available instrument before you trade.


## No KYC for core trading. Private and onchain.


Sign in with Apple or Google and use Freeport's core trading experience without KYC. Your assets settle to an onchain wallet tied to your account, giving you direct control and greater privacy than a traditional pooled brokerage ledger. Fund with a card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, or a bank transfer, or send USDC from Robinhood, Coinbase, another exchange, or a wallet. Some card and bank funding partners may require their own verification.


## Built by professional options market makers


Freeport was founded by former Jane Street and IMC options market makers. That professional trading background shapes the product around execution, pricing, and market structure—not engagement gimmicks.


## A social feed from sources you already trust


Follow the analysts, X accounts, publications, and market voices you already rely on. Freeport organizes those sources into one customizable feed, so your information starts with people you chose rather than a generic algorithm.


## AI summaries for what is worth your attention


Freeport's AI condenses market news and social posts into short summaries, connects developments to the markets they affect, and highlights what is actually worth reviewing. You get the context without having to read every headline or post yourself.


The idea is simple: more markets, more hours, professional tools, and one private account built to make all of it easy to use.


See the markets available to you.


[Download Freeport](https://freeportmarkets.com/download.html)
